headline: 3つの調節薬の併用で、ドーパミンの効きが1000倍以上に
subhead: TM1とTM7の間にある新しい2つの溝に結合する調節薬を、クライオ電顕で解いた
target_label: ドーパミンD1受容体（ヒト）

summary.question: アロステリック部位（作動薬と別の結合場所）が協調する仕組みは分かっていなかった。結合部位が確かめられた調節薬は LY3154207 だけだった。
summary.approach: 新しい調節薬 UNC9815・UNC10062 を作り、BMS-A1 などと組み合わせた D1R-Gs 複合体をクライオ電顕で解き、変異体と MD でも調べた。
summary.result: 2.44〜2.65 Å の構造で、BMS-A1 は TM1・TM7 間の下の溝、UNC 化合物は真上の溝に入った。3種の併用でドーパミンの EC50 は1000倍以上下がった。
summary.learned: 3つの調節薬は重ならない3か所に同時に結合して協調する。MD は、複数部位への結合が受容体の活性型を安定化することを示した。
summary.open: 治療効果の向上や副作用の軽減につながるかは、今後の薬理学や in vivo の研究で確かめる必要がある。

question.quote: Although multiple allosteric binding sites have been identified in GPCRs, whether and how these spatially distinct sites cooperate to regulate receptor activation remain poorly understood.
the molecular basis underlying this allosteric cooperativity remains poorly understood, with only the binding site of LY3154207 definitively characterized to date

approach.quote: We developed two novel D1R positive allosteric modulators (PAMs), UNC9815 and UNC10062, and used cryo–electron microscopy to structurally identify two previously uncharacterized D1R allosteric sites occupied by UNC9815/UNC10062 and another D1R PAM, BMS-A1.
To confirm the above structural findings, we performed extensive mutagenesis experiments targeting the PAM contact residues within the D1R TM1-TM7 upper and lower allosteric pockets.

result.quote: The cryo-EM structures of D1R-Gs in complex with SKF81297/LY3154207/BMS-A1, SKF81297/LY3154207/BMS-A1/UNC10062, and DA/LY3154207/BMS-A1/UNC9815 were determined at global resolutions of 2.65, 2.59, and 2.44 Å, respectively
are organized in a spatially complementary manner as vertically adjacent binding pockets
When all three chemically distinct classes of PAMs were combined with DA, we observed a ≥1000-fold shift in the DA EC50

learned.quote: Our structures demonstrate the simultaneous binding of the chemically distinct PAMs (LY3154207, BMS-A1, and UNC9815/UNC10062) in three nonoverlapping pockets.
Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed that multisite PAM engagement restricts intracellular loop 3 dynamics

open.quote: However, whether this strategy can ultimately improve therapeutic efficacy, broaden therapeutic windows, or reduce adverse effects remains to be determined through future pharmacological and in vivo studies.

highlights.text: 下の溝に BMS-A1、その真上の溝に UNC9815/UNC10062 が入る。2つの調節薬が縦に積み重なる配置は、論文の知る限り他の GPCR で報告がない。上の溝にはコレステロールが入った構造もあった。

evidence.quote: The stacked arrangement of two PAMs sandwiched between TM1 and TM7 represents, to our knowledge, a previously unknown allosteric binding configuration in other GPCRs.
In the map of D1R-SKF81297/LY3154207/BMS-A1, we observed a clear density of cholesterol at a site similar to that occupied by the UNC compounds

highlights.text: UNC 化合物は MLS6585 を最適化したもの。上の溝の3残基（V315A・F319L・A322S）を置換すると、UNC9815 は効きを弱める調節薬（NAM）に変わった。下の溝の変異では BMS-A1 が働かなくなった。

evidence.quote: we first optimized MLS6585 through medicinal chemistry, yielding two analogs, UNC10062 and UNC9815, with enhanced potency and efficacy
However, UNC9815 unexpectedly behaved as a weak negative allosteric modulator (NAM) when tested alone or in combination with BMS-A1 or LY3154207
BMS-A1 was rendered functionally inactive for altering DA potency either alone or in combination with UNC9815 or LY3154207

highlights.text: G タンパク質のない MD では、ICL3 の動きと NPxxY モチーフのゆらぎが、3種そろうと LY3154207 だけのときより小さくなった。細胞外ループ ECL2 のゆらぎも 2.46 ± 0.77 Å から 0.87 ± 0.11 Å に減った。

evidence.quote: Multisite PAM engagement produced stabilizing effects not achieved by LY3154207 alone.

Root mean square fluctuation analyses revealed a progressive reduction in ECL2 flexibility: from 2.46 ± 0.77 Å in the D1R-SKF81297-only system to 1.98 ± 0.09 Å in the D1R-SKF81297/LY3154207 system and 0.87 ± 0.11 Å in the triple PAM-bound system

lab_notes.expression: Sf9 昆虫細胞に D1R・miniGαs_DN・Gβ1・Gγ2 のバキュロウイルスを 1:1:1:1 で共感染。
lab_notes.construct: ヒト D1R の N 末に FLAG と β2AR N 末断片、C 末に 8×His。miniGαs は G226A・A366S 変異体。
lab_notes.purification: LMNG と CHS で可溶化し、FLAG 樹脂とゲルろ過で精製。全試料に LY3154207 を加えた。
lab_notes.sample_prep: Quantifoil R1.2/1.3 に 3 μL（10.9〜16.0 mg/ml）をのせ、Vitrobot Mark IV で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios で 6,244〜8,517 本の動画を収集。RELION 4.0 と cryoSPARC v4 で処理し、7LJC を初期モデルに精密化。

evidence.quote: For the expression of the D1R-Gs complexes, Sf9 cells (Spodoptera frugiperda; Expression Systems, catalog no. 94-001F; RRID:CVCL_0549) were coinfected with the four types of baculoviruses prepared at 1:1:1:1 ratio.
evidence.section: Expression, assembly, and purification of D1R-Gs complexes

evidence.quote: The N-terminal of D1R sequence was induced with FLAG tag followed by a fragment of β2AR N-terminal tail region (BN, hereafter) as fusion protein while the C-terminal was attached with an 8 × His tag to facilitate the protein expression and purification
A miniGαs format of Gαs with dominant negative mutations, G226A and A366S, was engineered (miniGαs_DN)
solubilized directly by 0.5% (w/v) lauryl maltose neopentyl glycol (LMNG; Anatrace) and 0.1% (w/v) cholesteryl hemisuccinate tris salt (CHS; Anatrace)
evidence.section: Expression, assembly, and purification of D1R-Gs complexes

evidence.quote: For the preparation of cryo-EM grids, 3 μl of the purified complexes at 10.9 mg/ml for the D1R-Gs complex with SKF81297/LY3154207/BMS-A1
evidence.section: Cryo-EM grid preparation and data collection

evidence.quote: Grids were plunge-frozen in liquid ethane using Vitrobot Mark IV (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
evidence.section: Cryo-EM grid preparation and data collection

evidence.quote: all collected movie stacks were motion-corrected and dose-weighted in RELION 4.0
was used as initial model for model rebuilding and refinement against the cryo-EM density maps of D1R-Gs complexes

editor_notes: candidates.json の source は impact_search だが kind は new_structure（9WEU・9WG0・9WG6 の3エントリ、PDB の引用題は別題 'Molecular insights into the cooperative allosteric modulation of D1 dopamine receptor' で DOI 未登録）。1000倍以上は β-arrestin 回収アッセイの DA の EC50 シフト（SKF81297 では3種でも2種を超えず頭打ち）。MD は補助的な裏付けとして書き、結果は著者の解釈（示唆）の範囲にとどめた。legend_labels は未設定（β2AR-D1R-NanoLuc 融合鎖・Nb35・Gα/β/γ の順を render 後に確認してほしい）。
